Our Story

Delivering Excellence, Building Trust

A B KHAN & ASSOCIATES is a premier Chartered Accountancy firm providing comprehensive financial and compliance solutions to businesses, startups, professionals and individuals. What started as a focused accounting and tax practice has grown into a full-service firm covering Accounting, Taxation, Audit, GST, Company Registration, ROC Compliance, Payroll, Financial Advisory and Business Consultancy.

Every engagement is handled with the same standard: accurate work, clear communication, and deadlines that are never missed. That discipline is what has kept our client relationships running for years, not just filing seasons.
